# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release of RadiomicsJ (Maven Central and PyPI).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report a vulnerability privately, not in a public issue: use "Report a vulnerability"
under the Security tab of this repository, or write to t_kobayashi@vis-ionary.com.

Say which version you used and how to reproduce the problem. You will get an answer
within a few days; the fix and the disclosure are agreed with you.
